title: Accounts Receivable and Credit Policies Management
overview: A significant portion of a company’s working capital is tied to Accounts Receivable (AR), creating potential liquidity risks. This course provides in-depth knowledge and practical skills to effectively manage AR processes, enabling organizations to optimize cash flow without compromising credit sales.
audience: This course is designed for AR department managers, credit managers, AR staff, revenue accountants, credit officers, billing and collection clerks, and AR specialists. It is also beneficial for professionals in accounting, finance, operations, and sales who work closely with AR and credit functions.
methodology: This program combines theoretical insights with hands-on practices, including role-playing exercises and participant presentations. Additionally, Microsoft Excel is introduced as a key tool for managing and analyzing accounts receivable.
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: Develop and implement credit policies aligned with organizational goals.
Apply best practices in billing to improve accuracy and efficiency.
Establish effective collection strategies to minimize outstanding receivables.
Collaborate with sales teams to balance credit risk and sales growth.
Evaluate and optimize AR processes using industry best practices.
Use advanced tools and techniques to monitor and enhance AR performance.

items.text: The five Cs of credit and non-financial considerations
Components of an effective credit policy:
Mission and objectives of the credit department
Financial statement analysis and ratio interpretation
Establishing credit limits and fostering profitable customer relationships
The impact of operational accuracy on billing outcomes
Tips and techniques for faster collections
Creating and implementing a collection policy
Exploring AR factoring, pledging, and assignment
Building strong relationships between sales and credit teams
Maintaining credit sales while minimizing risk
Sales team involvement in credit issuance and collection processes
AR aging and bad-debt reserves management
Managing AR using a portfolio strategy:
Developing targeted approaches for specific segments
Implementing internal controls for AR processes
AR’s role in monthly account closings
Pros and cons of outsourcing AR functions
